request.initial_prompt: "No, not forgotten," retorted Estella,—"not forgotten, but treasured up in my memory. When have you found me false to your teaching? When have you found me unmindful of your lessons? When have you found me giving admission here," she touched her bosom with her hand, "to anything that you excluded? Be just to me."

No, not forgotten," retorted Estella—"not forgotten, but treasured up in my memory.
When have you found me false to your teaching?
When have you found me unmindful of your lessons?
When have you found me giving admission here?"
